description: Delete one note with the write token. Its text and vector are removed and it leaves the search at once. Its place in the 500-note lifetime limit stays used. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

note_id.description: The note_id from add_semantic_search_notes or a search.

write_token.description: The write_token from create_semantic_search, shown once. It adds and deletes notes.

name: delete_semantic_search_note
title: Delete a note from a semantic search collection
